title: Proximal Galerkin for the isometry constraint
summary: We resolve a longstanding open problem in the computational modeling of nonlinear plates by introducing a numerical method that exactly enforces the isometry constraint, namely, that the first fundamental form of the mid-surface coincides with the identity tensor. Several numerical methods have been proposed to approximate solutions of such manifold-constrained variational problems using gradient flows with tangent space updates.
